title: kotschya carsonii subsp. reflexa
intro: Kotschya carsonii subsp. reflexa, commonly known as Bushwillow, is a plant species belonging to the family Fabaceae. The Bushwillow plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Bushwillow include wound healing, pain relief, and the management of fever, among others. The bioactive constituents responsible for these properties include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which have been identified in studies on the plant's extracts.
